title: BankId Connector Configuration
description: Configuration for BankId Connector. This schema defines the necessary properties for configuring the connection to BankId services, including environment selection and authentication details.

environment.description: Environment for the requests. Use 'SANDBOX' for testing with the thirdparty's test backend system and 'PRODUCTION' for live transactions

certificate.description: CA certificate or certificate chain used to verify the remote server.

privateKey.description: PFX bundle containing the certificate and private key. Provided as the content itself.
